discussion.body: Act 6 storyboard. Locations: south road, Tierso, Temple of Life, Temple of Light. Joins: Ysolde locks in (FEAT-034); Maera (FEAT-036) at Light. Beats: blight in the Tierso fields; Life dungeon and Root Sigil; Light dungeon and Meridian Sigil; both temples are described as Fissure-seals, not Cannon fuel; preview choice (bind temples vs let Vortan fire) is a conversation, not a route fork. Death crises: Ysolde at the blight ward if the party splits wrong; Maera at beacon collapse if no one stays on the lamp. Defaults live. Contingency: Sigils can be taken from altar and beacon with no owner. Frames: Tierso, life grove, blight ward, light stair, beacon.
